spans.s:
कौञ्च कौञ्च, अस्, m., N. of a mountain,
part of the Himālaya range; [cf. क्रौञ्च.]

कौञ्जर कौञ्जर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुञ्जर),
belonging to an elephant; (अस्), m., N. of a race.

कौञ्जायन कौञ्जायन, आस्, m. pl. (fr. कुञ्ज),
N. of a mountain-tribe, descended from Kuñja; (ई),
f. a princess of this tribe; a female descendant of
Kuñja; the wife of a Brāhman or any venerable
personage.

कौञ्जायन्य, अस्, m. a prince of the mountain-
tribe called Kauñjāyana.
